materialPolicy: G/W/S share full8-neighbor ground occupancy. S is stone_bridge with its own structural supports; never normalize S to G. No collision/footprint/game logic changes.
sourcePolicy: 303 approved quiet V10 grass top sprites retained byte-identical. Other 1425 terrain sprites and four optional bridge illustrations use newly generated native V11 RGB with crop/scale/repeat/mask production only. Certified V10 alpha and dark edge guides remain. No RGB quantization or painting.
